name: Work & Career
tagline: Jobs, ambition, enterprise and the future of work
blurb: Six cue cards. Draws almost entirely on the Work and Success material from the 2025 corpus.

items: What kind of work do you do?
What do you find most interesting about your work?
Which is more important to you — the people you work with or the work you do?
Do you work best in the morning or the afternoon?
What do you study?
What do you find most interesting about your studies?
Which is more important to you — the teachers or the other students?
How much time do you spend studying every week?
Are you looking forward to working?
Where did you go to school?
Do you think your school is good for every student?
What changes do you want to make in your school?

p2.t: Describe a person you know who did something difficult and was successful
b: Who this person is
What he or she did
How difficult it was
And explain how you feel about this person

p2.t: Describe a long-term goal or ambition you would like to achieve
b: How long you have had this ambition
What it is
How you will achieve it
And explain why you set it

p2.t: Describe a person you know who would like to choose a career in the medical field
b: When you got to know him or her
When he or she started thinking about it
What he or she would like to do
And explain why he or she would choose this career

p2.t: Describe a time when you worked in a group
b: When and where it was
What the group had to do
What your role was
And explain how you felt about working in that group

p2.t: Describe a person you know who has a successful business
b: Who this person is
How you got to know him or her
Why and how he or she started the business
And explain why you think the business is successful

p2.t: Describe a person who works in a successful company
b: Who this person is
What the company does
What this person's role is
And explain why you think the company is successful

items: What do you think are the characteristics of a good leader?
What happens if a team does not have a good leader?
Why do some people not like teamwork?
Do you think young people are suitable for teamwork?
How do other people in a team judge one another?
What kinds of ambitions do people have?
Why should parents encourage children to have ambitions?
Should parents interfere with children's ambitions?
Is there any difference between children's ambitions and those of adults?
Why do some people choose to work in the medical field?
How does working in a medical profession affect a person's life?
Do you think medical professionals are valued in society?
Which profession is more important, doctors or nurses?
How might technology change medical professions in future?
What qualities are essential to succeed in a medical profession?
Would you like to start a family business?
What are the advantages and disadvantages of family businesses?
Why do some businesses succeed while others fail?
